Feature: Per-Function PCIe Capabilities and BAR Config
Test Description: Exercise PCIe link bring-up for selected instance/role, configure coherency control fields, poll link/PHY readiness, and validate basic PCIe configuration-space behavior by probing and programming BARs and enabling the command register. A scratch register is used for synchronization to determine test completion.
Meta Test Description: The test_case() function performs the following logic: 1) Initialize a scratch register: write_reg(0xE6004100, 0x0). 2) Link training based on compile-time role: if DM0_RC or DM0_EP then link_training_dm0_x4(4); if DM1_RC or DM1_EP then link_training_dm1_x4(4). 3) DBI coherency programming: For PCIe0, read mizar_PCIE0_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF, set fields [11:14]=0xF and [3:6]=0xF, write back; then read again, set [27:30]=0xF and [19:22]=0xF, write back. Repeat the same two-step sequence for PCIe1 using mizar_PCIE1_DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF. 4) Wait: wait_on(20). Then for PCIe0 and PCIe1 recompute the value by reading their respective DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3 registers and setting all four fields [11:14], [3:6], [27:30], [19:22] to 0xF in a single composite write for each instance. 5) Read SII status for instance0: data_rd = read_sii0_reg(0xC0); call non_secure_prot_nic(); then loop while ((data_rd & 0xD1) != 0xD1) updating data_rd = read_sii0_reg(0xC0). 6) If DM1_RC, repeat SII status polling for instance1: loop while ((read_sii1_reg(0xC0) & 0xD1) != 0xD1). 7) Synchronization: write_reg(0xE6004100, 0x11111111) and wait_on(15000). 8) If DM0_RC: call mem_base_program_dm0_x4(); small delay wait_on(10); read ten config dwords via read_pcie_slv0_reg(i*4) for i=0..9; BAR size probe by writing 0xFFFFFFFF to offsets 0x10..0x24 (BAR0..BAR5) and reading back; program BARs with 0x0, 0x4, 0x20000000, 0x40000000, 0x60000000, 0x80000000; enable command register by write_pcie_slv0_reg(0x4, 0x7). 9) If DM1_RC: call mem_base_program_dm1_x4(); read ten config dwords via read_pcie_slv1_reg(i*4); enable command register write_pcie_slv1_reg(0x4, 0x7); perform BAR size probe writes of 0xFFFFFFFF to 0x10..0x24 and reads; then program BARs with 0x0, 0x4, 0x20000000, 0x40000000, 0x60000000, 0x80000000; read back BAR dwords. 10) Final handshake: wait_on(10); poll read_reg(0xE6004100) until it equals 0x12345678 with periodic wait_on(5); when matched, finish(0).
Remarks: Behavior depends on compile-time role/instance macros (DM0_RC/DM1_RC/DM0_EP/DM1_EP). Test requires link_training_dm*_x4, non_secure_prot_nic, and PCIe config-space accessor helpers. SII status readiness is required before proceeding. Test completion depends on an external writer updating 0xE6004100 to 0x12345678.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1) Initialize the scratch register at 0xE6004100 to 0x0. 2) Train the PCIe link for the selected instance/role (DM0/DM1, RC/EP). 3) Program coherency control fields in DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3 for PCIe0 and PCIe1 instances, then apply a combined update after a short wait. 4) Configure NIC non-secure protection and poll SII_STATUS until link/PHY indicates ready for the required instance(s). 5) Write 0x11111111 to 0xE6004100 and wait briefly. 6) If acting as Root Complex on instance 0: set up memory base, probe BAR sizes (write 0xFFFFFFFF), read them back, program BAR base addresses, and enable Memory/IO/Bus Master in the command register. 7) If acting as Root Complex on instance 1: perform analogous BAR probing/programming and command enable. 8) Poll 0xE6004100 until it reaches 0x12345678, then declare PASS.
